summary: Rebuild a run tree for this node's own claims only when another writer's claims arrive for it

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild is added. The incremental replication projection rebuilds fewer run trees: a tree that holds this node's own claims alone, which were applied when written, is no longer rebuilt on every pass; a local work extension still is. The projection digest after a pass equals a full replay's in the new test and in the existing replication, convergence and work-extension tests.

schema.detail: No database tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema version change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption is introduced.

recovery.detail: No database recovery change; an older build rebuilds every such tree as before.
